pipeline.title: Pipeline 8 giai doan
pipeline.description: Moi tin nhan di qua 8 giai doan co cau truc trong 3 pha.
pipeline.setupDesc: Lam giau context voi cau hinh agent, workspace, lich su nguoi dung, va ky uc tu phien truoc.
pipeline.iterationDesc: Lap lai cho den khi hoan thanh hoac dat gioi han.
pipeline.thinkDesc: LLM suy luan voi day du context
pipeline.pruneDesc: Quan ly token va nen lich su
pipeline.toolsDesc: Thuc thi tool call tu LLM
pipeline.observeDesc: Thu thap va xac nhan ket qua
pipeline.finalizeDesc: Luu metadata, phat su kien cho consolidation bo nho, va don dep.

memory.title: He thong bo nho 3 tang
memory.description: Bo nho luy tien tu hoi thoai den tri thuc dai han.
memory.l0Desc: Lich su phien voi nen tu dong theo token. Khi lich su vuot nguong, tin nhan cu duoc tom tat qua LLM va cat bot. Memory flush trich xuat du lieu quan trong truoc khi nen.
memory.l1Desc: Tom tat phien tao sau moi lan chay. Moi ban tom tat co L0 abstract (~50 token) de inject nhanh. Tim kiem FTS + vector voi TTL 90 ngay. Abstract lien quan duoc tu dong inject vao system prompt moi luot.
memory.l2Desc: Do thi tri thuc voi thuc the va quan he trich xuat qua LLM (nguong 0.75). Tu dong ghep trung. Dreaming tong hop 5+ ban tom tat thanh tai lieu kien thuc dai han.
memory.eventFlow: Su kien: session.completed kich hoat tao L1, tiep tuc kich hoat trich xuat L2 va dreaming.

knowledge.kgDesc: Thuc the (nguoi, du an, cong nghe) va quan he duoc trich xuat tu tom tat phien qua LLM. Phien ban thoi gian theo doi khi du lieu hop le. Tim kiem qua knowledge_graph_search voi duyet da buoc den 5 cap.
knowledge.vaultDesc: So dang ky tai lieu voi [[wikilink]]. Tim kiem ket hop vault (40%) + episodic (30%) + KG (30%). SHA-256 phat hien thay doi noi dung.
knowledge.dreamingDesc: Khi 5+ ban tom tat phien tich luy, LLM tong hop du lieu dai han: so thich nguoi dung, kien truc du an, mau lap lai, quyet dinh quan trong. Luu lam tai lieu tim kiem duoc. Debounce 10 phut moi agent.

orchestration.delegateDesc: Agent uy quyen nhiem vu cho agent duoc lien ket qua agent_links voi kiem tra quyen. Che do dong bo cho ket qua. Che do bat dong bo phat ngay va thong bao ket qua sau.
orchestration.evolutionDesc: Theo doi su dung tool va retrieval hang tuan. Phat hien 3 mau: su dung retrieval thap (< 20%), ty le loi tool cao (< 10%), va mau tool lap lai (> 100 lan/tuan). De xuat dieu chinh cau hinh voi tu dong ap dung co bao ve.
